title: What Is RAG? How AI Looks Things Up (20 Seconds)
description:
RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) searches an outside knowledge base first, then gives the question and the relevant info to the model, so it can answer with up-to-date facts and cite sources without retraining.

The refund-policy question and the documents shown are an illustrative example, not a real system.

Narration is a synthetic voice (VoiceStudio). Animation is written as code.
